id: 6f3b2c1a-2d54-4f0e-9c8a-7b1e4a9d2c11
description: Detects java/python archive-extraction runtimes writing files into autostart/web-root/system directories or to paths retaining a raw .. traversal sequence, the arbitrary-file-write outcome of a Zip Slip exploit (CVE-2018-8008, CVE-2018-8009).
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/behind-the-disclosure-the-zip-slip-vulnerability/
  - https://github.com/snyk/zip-slip-vulnerability
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2018-8009
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/30
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1547.001
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\'
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\'
      - '\webapps\'
      - '\System32\'
      - '..'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_path
level: medium

id: b3f1c2a4-5d6e-4f70-8a91-2c3d4e5f6071
status: experimental
description: Detects an FTP-download runtime (Apache Hive commons-net, node, or CLI ftp client) writing to Unix credential/SSH files, the impact of the CVE-2018-1315 path-traversal LIST response.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/attacking-an-ftp-client/
  - https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JAVA-ORGAPACHEHIVE-31662
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/30
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1098.004
  - attack.t1565.001
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_paths:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
      - '/etc/sudoers'
      - '/.ssh/authorized_keys'

      - '/java'
      - '/hive'
      - '/beeline'
      - '/node'
      - '/ftp'
      - '/lftp'

description: Detects a node process spawning a shell or transfer tool whose command line reads /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow, matching the Dust.js RCE post-exploit child_process curl exfil chain.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/type-manipulation/
  - https://artsploit.blogspot.com/2016/08/pprce2.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/30
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1003.008
  - attack.t1041
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/nodejs'
      - '\node.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
      - 'child_process'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
level: high
4549.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node","node.exe","nodejs")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","curl","wget")) AND (Processes.process="*/etc/passwd*" OR Processes.process="*/etc/shadow*" OR Processes.process="*child_process*" OR Processes.process="*curl*-F*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process, Processes.process_name, Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| sort - count
